item.title: AFB: 2026 Forklift Vehicle Purchase
item.description: The Madison Metropolitan Sewerage District requests bids for the 2026 Forklift Vehicle Purchase. Sealed bids will be accepted until 10:00 a.m., Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at the District office.

item.title: PFAS Testing of Wastewater and Biosolids Consultant
item.description: The District requests proposals for PFAS consulting services. Proposals must be received by 2:00 p.m., Friday, October 30, 2026.

item.title: RFP for Pumping Station 2 Force Main Condition Assessment
item.description:
The Madison Metropolitan Sewerage District requests proposals for the Pumping Station 2 Force Main Condition Assessment project. The project documents are available at QuestCDN.com.
